requirements.text: Publish only complete media renditions with owner and immutable expiration.
Enforce current audience membership and monotonic viewed state.
Hide expired stories at read time and reconcile asynchronous purge.

problem.scope: Photo/video publishing, audience checks, viewing and a 24-hour visibility lifetime. Authored practice extends the catalogue; physical deletion and backup retention are separate from visibility expiry.

acceptanceCases.given: A published story expires at time 100 and its viewer is in the current audience.
acceptanceCases.then: Only the time-99 read by the allowed viewer succeeds.
acceptanceCases.when: The expiry guard authorizes a read at 99 and at 100, then at 99 after the viewer is revoked.

acceptanceCases.given: An upload has two renditions and only one digest is verified.
acceptanceCases.then: The story stays pending and invisible, and the retry returns the same pending story rather than a second one.
acceptanceCases.when: The client publishes the story, then retries the same command.

acceptanceCases.given: A story expires at 100 but deletion is delayed.
acceptanceCases.then: Every path is rejected by the expiry guard; pending byte deletion is reported separately.
acceptanceCases.when: Read at 100 through the tray, metadata, media and view paths.

acceptanceCases.given: A friend loses access after a tray cursor is issued.
acceptanceCases.then: Recheck current audience and deny the revoked viewer.

acceptanceCases.given: Two devices record the same story view in reverse order.
acceptanceCases.then: Viewed remains true and no retry clears it.
